title: Testicles and Scrotum
summary: The testicles are the two glands in the scrotum that produce sperm and testosterone. The scrotum hangs outside the body to keep them slightly cooler than body temperature.
key_points: One testicle often hangs lower than the other; that's normal.
Sudden severe testicle pain is an emergency (it could be torsion).
A monthly self-check for lumps can help catch testicular cancer early.
